# {{ site.author }} (muhamed.at)

> Personal site of {{ site.author }}: Ruby/Rails engineer and AI product developer, contributor to enola and maintainer of four related gems, creator of pi-brain, organizer of RubyConf Austria (and EuRuKo 2024 before it). The site has two content sections: a raw, AI-assisted "brain stream" of notes and links, and longer human-written essays under "writing". It also describes consulting and training services for AI-augmented development.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. All pages are static HTML and easy to fetch. Feeds carry full content.

## Key pages

- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): bio, career history, specialties, open source work
- [Services]({{ site.url }}/services/): consulting, workshops, and fractional AI product engineering for Rails teams
- [Writing]({{ site.url }}/writing/): longer essays, written by a human
- [Brain stream]({{ site.url }}/): short notes on what I am reading and building, organized with AI assistance
- [Tags]({{ site.url }}/tags/): tag index across both sections

## Feeds

- [Writing feed]({{ site.url }}/feed.xml): Atom feed of essays
- [Brain stream feed]({{ site.url }}/brain.xml): Atom feed of the brain stream
- [Sitemap]({{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml)

## Open source

- [pi-brain](https://github.com/misabegovic/pi-brain): a cloneable, agent-maintained knowledge base; this site runs on a clone of it
- [enola](https://rubygems.org/gems/enola): pure-Ruby wrapper gem for the enola architecture intelligence binary (maintainer)
- [enola-rb](https://rubygems.org/gems/enola-rb): the Rails layer for enola (maintainer)
- [enola-guides](https://rubygems.org/gems/enola-guides): the content layer for enola, guides and law catalogue (maintainer)
- [munola](https://rubygems.org/gems/munola): a personal channel on top of enola with a built-in recipe catalogue (maintainer)
